groups.sentence: Instructors decide whether English language learners may write their original drafts in another language.
Students may use AI to translate text from one language to another.
Students must not use translation software to translate or transform their own work, and must write directly in English.
Students may use AI to learn writing conventions such as vocabulary, sentence structure and genres, or to transform their own work into another genre.
AI translation can benefit language learners and help show refined linguistic ability.
Students may use AI translation tools for consultation, but must not present the AI translation as their own text.
Students who use AI for translation discuss its implications and limitations with the instructor.
Submitting AI-translated text as original work without disclosure is not acceptable use.
